desc: A tool to remove a multipath device and its scsi path devices
r: mpathcleanup - A tool to remove a multipath device and its scsi path devices
mpathcleanup is a utility that attempts to remove a multipath device and its underlying paths. It only works for multipath devices built on top of scsi devices.

--flush
Disable queueing on the multipath device and flush the path devices before removing.
-h|--help
Display help text.
